description: Unit test class for the JsonFactory utility in the Eclipse Ditto project, verifying JSON parsing, object creation, field definitions, and value conversions.

classes.name: JsonFactoryTest
classes.description: Contains unit tests for the JsonFactory class, testing JSON creation, parsing, field definitions, and value mappings.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Checks that JsonFactory class is immutable.

methods.name: tryToGetNewKeyFromNullString
methods.description: Tests that creating a JsonKey from null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToGetNewKeyFromEmptyString
methods.description: Tests that creating a JsonKey from an empty string throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: newKeyFromAlreadyExistingKeyReturnsExistingKey
methods.description: Verifies that requesting a JsonKey for an existing key returns the same instance.

methods.name: newJsonStringFromNullReturnsNullValue
methods.description: Ensures that creating a JsonValue from null yields a null JsonValue.

methods.name: newJsonStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that creating a JsonValue from a string produces correct JSON string representation.

methods.name: nullLiteralReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that the null literal JsonValue is correctly returned.

methods.name: newValueFromTrueReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests creation of a JsonValue from boolean true.

methods.name: newValueFromFalseReturnsExpected
methods.description: Tests creation of a JsonValue from boolean false.

methods.name: newValueFromIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of JsonValue from an integer.

methods.name: newValueFromMaxIntReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of JsonValue from maximum integer value.

methods.name: newValueFromLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of JsonValue from a long.

methods.name: newValueFromMaxLongReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of JsonValue from maximum long.

methods.name: newValueFromDoubleReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of JsonValue from a double.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectBuilderFromNullObject
methods.description: Ensures that passing null to create a new object builder throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: newObjectReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies that new object creation yields an empty JsonObject.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectFromNullMap
methods.description: Ensures that null map input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNewObjectFromMap
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject from a map of keys and values and verifies contents.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectFromNullString
methods.description: Checks that null string input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectFromEmptyString
methods.description: Checks that empty string input throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectFromNonsenseString
methods.description: Checks that nonsensical string input throws JsonParseException.

methods.name: newObjectFromStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies parsing of a valid JSON object string yields expected JsonObject.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewObjectBuilderFromNullIterable
methods.description: Ensures null iterable throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNewEmptyArray
methods.description: Verifies creation of a new empty JsonArray.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewArrayFromEmptyString
methods.description: Checks that empty string throws IllegalArgumentException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewArrayFromNonsenseString
methods.description: Checks that invalid string causes JsonParseException.

methods.name: newArrayFromStringReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies parsing a JSON array string yields correct JsonArray.

methods.name: tryToReadJsonValueFromInvalidString
methods.description: Checks that malformed JSON causes JsonParseException.

methods.name: tryToReadJsonObjectFromInvalidInput
methods.description: Checks that invalid JSON input causes JsonParseException.

methods.name: readFromJsonValueString
methods.description: Verifies reading JSON value from a string.

methods.name: readFromJsonPrimitiveString
methods.description: Verifies reading a JSON primitive string.

methods.name: tryToReadFromNullReader
methods.description: Ensures passing null reader throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: readFromJsonArrayStringReader
methods.description: Tests reading a JsonArray from a StringReader.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewFieldSelectorWithNullSet
methods.description: Guarantees null input to newFieldSelector throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: emptyFieldSelector
methods.description: Verifies that an empty field selector reports as empty.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorBuilder
methods.description: Returns a new builder for field selectors.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorWithEmptySetReturnsEmptyFieldSelector
methods.description: Tests that an empty set returns an empty field selector.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewFieldSelectorWithNullMandatoryPointer
methods.description: Ensures null pointer input throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateNewFieldSelectorWithNullFurtherPointers
methods.description: Checks that null in parameter list throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorFromPointersReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies correct creation of a field selector from multiple JsonPointer objects.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorFromPointerStringsReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies creation of a field selector from string pointers.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorFromNullStringIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures null string input results in empty field selector.

methods.name: newFieldSelectorFromEmptyStringIsEmpty
methods.description: Ensures empty string input results in empty field selector.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueReturnsNullLiteralForNull
methods.description: Checks that null input yields null literal JsonValue.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueForJsonArrayReturnsJsonArray
methods.description: Verifies that a JsonArray input is returned as is.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueForCharSequenceReturnsJsonStringValue
methods.description: Verifies that a string input yields a JsonString value.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueForBoxedBooleanReturnsJsonBooleanValue
methods.description: Verifies boxed Boolean inputs convert properly.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueForBoxedDoubleReturnsJsonDoubleValue
methods.description: Verifies boxed Double inputs convert properly.

methods.name: getAppropriateValueForJsonObjectStringReturnsJsonStringValue
methods.description: Verifies that string representation of JSON object yields a JsonString value.
